title: XPOCK HX-241 Integration Schemas Index
description: Index of all JSON schemas in the 241-integration module. These schemas define portable, language-agnostic data formats that map XPOCK's computational outputs to HX-241's Rust types and interfaces.

capacity_analysis_result.description: CapacityAnalysisResult - for hx-sim benchmark configuration and session dimensioning

carrier_channel_model.description: CarrierChannelModel - physical wave propagation model output

hx241_integration_points.carrier_channel_model: Physical layer simulation - not part of HX-241 core

architectural_compliance.no_conventional_stack: No IP/TCP/UDP/QUIC/DNS/HTTP dependencies in any schema
architectural_compliance.carrier_agnostic: HX-241 protocol logic is not modified or dependent on these schemas
architectural_compliance.capabilities_are_hints: I-CARR-005: All carrier capabilities are HINTS only

usage.step1: XPOCK generates carrier channel models from physical parameters
usage.step2: Channel models are converted to CarrierCapabilities and NetworkImpairment params
usage.step3: JSON test vectors are consumed by hx-sim's ImpairmentEngine and benchmark suite
usage.step4: Rust implementations deserialize JSON with serde and map to native types
